build_transformer_from_name: build a Transformer model from a config name like 8B or 70B using Transformer.from_name
create_model_args_from_name: create a ModelArgs dataclass from a model name string using ModelArgs.from_name with fuzzy matching
setup_transformer_caches: setup KVCache and frequency caches for a Transformer model using setup_caches with batch size and sequence length
run_transformer_forward: run a forward pass through the Transformer model with token indices and input positions to get logits
precompute_rotary_embeddings: precompute rotary position embedding frequencies using precompute_freqs_cis for a given sequence length and base
